units.source_text: 这件事之后的第二天，阿住终究因为一件小事，和阿民发生了激烈争执。

en.t: The next day after that incident, Azumi finally got into a fierce quarrel with Atami over a trivial matter.

units.source_text: 这里所说的小事，只是阿住吃了阿民的地瓜罢了。

en.t: The trivial matter in question was only that Azumi had eaten Atami's sweet potato.

units.source_text: 没想到越吵越凶，阿民嘲讽的冷笑，说道：“你不喜欢做事，那就去死啊！”

en.t: Unexpectedly, the quarrel grew fiercer and fiercer, and Atami laughed coldly in mockery and said, "If you hate working, then go die!"

units.source_text: 阿住听到这句话，跟以往不同，整个人疯狂的吼叫。

en.t: When Azumi heard those words, she was unlike her usual self and screamed wildly with her whole body.

units.source_text: 这时候，孙子广次刚好枕在祖母阿住的膝盖上酣睡。

en.t: Just then, her grandson Hirotsugu was sleeping soundly with his head on his grandmother Azumi's lap.

units.source_text: “阿广，醒醒！醒醒！”

en.t: "Ahiro, wake up! Wake up!"

units.source_text: 阿住一边摇晃孙子广次，一边不停的骂阿民：“阿广，醒醒！

en.t: As Azumi shook her grandson Hirotsugu, she kept cursing Atami: "Ahiro, wake up!

units.source_text: 阿广，醒醒！醒醒！

en.t: Ahiro, wake up! Wake up!

units.source_text: 起来听听你母亲说的什么混账话。

en.t: Get up and listen to the vile thing your mother said.

units.source_text: 你母亲让我去死啊！

en.t: Your mother told me to go die!

units.source_text: 你可要认真听清楚。

en.t: You had better listen carefully and understand.

units.source_text: 尽管你母亲赚了一点钱。

en.t: Even though your mother has earned a little money.

units.source_text: 但是那几亩田地都是爷爷奶奶开垦出来的呀！

en.t: But those few mu of fields were all cleared and cultivated by your grandfather and grandmother!

units.source_text: 但是那又如何呢？

en.t: But what difference does that make?

units.source_text: 你母亲竟然让我去死。

en.t: Your mother actually told me to die.

units.source_text: 阿民，早晚会死。

en.t: Atami will die sooner or later too.

units.source_text: 死没什么可怕的！

en.t: There is nothing frightening about death!

units.source_text: 不，我才不中你的计。

en.t: No, I will not fall for your scheme.

units.source_text: 我会死，我早晚会死。

en.t: I will die, I will die sooner or later.

units.source_text: 但我就算死也饶不过你……”

en.t: But even if I die, I will never forgive you..."
